name: @relationship-os/control
description: The hosted SaaS control plane (app.relationshiposcrm.com) and the dispatch Worker in front of every customer deployment: sign-up, plans, Stripe billing, provisioning on Workers for Platforms, staged rollouts, support grants, export and delete (ADR 0210-0215). Runs against fakes until PLATFORM_MODE=live (docs/saas-go-live.md).

scripts.types: wrangler types --strict-vars=false && wrangler types -c dispatch.wrangler.jsonc --strict-vars=false --env-interface DispatchEnv --include-runtime=false dispatch-configuration.d.ts
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --strict-vars=false --check && wrangler types -c dispatch.wrangler.jsonc --strict-vars=false --env-interface DispatchEnv --include-runtime=false dispatch-configuration.d.ts --check && tsc --noEmit
